text: BAM share fell 0.12 percentage points over 22 hours and 0.03 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 32.7% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.6% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 61 top-node leadership changes should be read as whale-driven routing, not validator turnover.
